verdict.rationale: xAI documents a first-party hosted MCP server that agents can connect to, but its scope is limited to giving agents access to the xAI documentation. Remote MCP Tools (grok-docs-12) is the client side, where Grok connects to external MCP servers, so it is not credited here; the probe pointing to that page is likewise client-side. Missing for 10: an MCP server exposing Grok API capabilities (inference, files, collections, management), setup and auth details for the docs server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: xAI hosts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants and agents direct access to the xAI documentation.
